'''Vanth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Private/Legends|private]]

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Vanth enlisted the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and became a [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[301st Infantry]]. By [[3642 BBY]], during the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the Empire, Vanth was assigned to the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he was selected to as part of a replacement [[Squad/Legends|squad]] for the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]]. Alongside fellow privates [[Dromol]], [[Edder]], [[Voshpar]], and [[Reico]], Vanth accompanied Sergeant Rusk to the [[Highmount Ridge]] region in order to rendezvous with the two [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] whom Rusk was aiding in their [[Mission to Hoth (Hunt for the Sith Emperor)|classified mission]]: [[Leeha Narezz]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]].<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />

However, the squad encountered several Imperial patrols on their way, as Hoth was currently the site of a [[Battle of Hoth (Galactic War)|three-way battle]] between the Empire, the Republic, and the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Vanth and Edder's inexperience nearly resulted in the [[Death/Legends|death]] of their fellow squad members, earning Dromol's scorn.
